study_note: Strictly compiled sibling of the seed-55 one-million-decision AMBI-XQC Humanoid Walk state screen. It preserves the eager run's complete scientific configuration and changes only the compilation mode plus W&B identity. TOLD uses recurrent three-step BPTT, while canonical action-local XQC uses J=2, N=32, H=3, and G=4. This remains a single-seed exploratory execution rather than a statistical or paper reproduction. W&B syncs online from node-local temporary storage; evaluations and portable best/latest checkpoints require an explicit durable result directory. Exact trainer resume is not supported.
